metadata.source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via existing JLV chart-build.js derivative
metadata.sourceRetrievedAtStatus: Not retained in existing chart files/build metadata; file mtime is not acquisition date.
metadata.coordinateSystem: GeoJSON WGS84 [longitude, latitude]; inverse of existing local east/south projection.
limitations: Existing chart derivation rounded local coordinates to1m and simplified lines/polygons1.5–2.5m; not original survey vertices.
Small apron/terminal features were filtered and relation inner holes were discarded by the original chart builder.
boundsLocalMeters is display framing only, NOT an airport boundary. No airport boundary polygon is available.
Building heights/materials are absent; no invented architectural heights supplied.
OSM IDs, versions, original retrieval timestamps and individual feature tags were not retained; derivative chart SHA is retained for provenance.
